::: {#def-fitted-value}
#### Fitted value

Suppose a model for the mean of an outcome $Y$ given a predictor $X$
has been fitted to data $(x_1, y_1), \ldots, (x_n, y_n)$.
The **fitted value** for observation $i$, written $\fitted_i$,
is the fitted model's estimate of
the mean outcome at that observation's predictor value,
$\E{Y \mid X = x_i}$.

For example, a simple linear regression fitted by
[ordinary least squares](correlation-regression.qmd#def-ols)
has fitted values
$\fitted_i = \hintcoef + \hcoef{x} x_i$.
:::
